result.stdout:
CleanArch Pro - Generate and enforce Clean Architecture automatically.

Usage:
  cleanarchpro <command> [options]

Commands:
  create <ProjectName>   Create a new Clean Architecture solution.
  validate               Scan and validate architecture rules in the current directory.
  doctor                 Generate a detailed architecture health report for the current solution.
  --version, -v          Show CLI version.
  --help, -h             Show this help screen.

Options for 'create':
  --docker               Include Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml configuration.
  --tests                Include xUnit unit and integration test projects.
  --github-actions       Include GitHub Actions CI workflow template.
  --azure-devops         Include Azure DevOps pipeline template.
  --all                  Include all the options above.

Examples:
  cleanarchpro create GiftCardSystem --all
  cleanarchpro validate
  cleanarchpro doctor
